title: Films, music, sport & free time
goal: Recommend and review dramas, films and songs, follow a cricket match with friends, say who the best player is, talk about your hobbies — and compare things properly.
intro:
In Sindh, free time means TV dramas that the whole family argues about, Sufi and folk music from Shah Latif to Coke Studio, and above all **cricket** — PSL nights with friends, Pakistan–India matches that stop the country. This unit gives you the words to join in.

The grammar is **comparison in depth**. You met کان 'than' and سڀ کان 'most' in unit 8. Now you'll say *much better*, *a bit less famous*, *not as good as* (**جيترو**), *one of the best* (… **مان هڪ**) and *the more you watch, the more you like it* (**جيترو … اوترو …**).

grammar.title: Comparing: much better, a bit less, not as … as (جيترو)
grammar.body:
The basic comparative is **X کان + adjective**: هي ان **کان** سٺو آهي 'this is better than that'. You can add **وڌيڪ** 'more' or **گهٽ** 'less' before the adjective: کان **وڌيڪ** مشهور 'more famous than', کان **گهٽ** مهانگو 'less expensive than'. The adjective still agrees with what's being described.

**How much more?** Put a size word before the adjective:
• گهڻو / ڪافي — much, quite a lot: ان کان **گهڻو** بهتر 'much better than that'
• ٿورو — a bit: **ٿورو** وڌيڪ 'a bit more'
These agree too: ٽيم **گهڻي** بهتر آهي (ٽيم is feminine).

**Not as … as**: use **جيترو** 'as much as' after the thing you compare with, agreeing with the subject:
هي ڊرامو ان **جيترو** سٺو ناهي — this drama isn't as good as that one
هيءَ فلم ان **جيتري** ڊگهي ناهي — this film isn't as long as that one
With a whole clause, use ايترو … جيترو: **ايتري** سٺي ناهي **جيتري** ماڻهو چون ٿا 'not as good as people say'.

**Preferences**: مون کي X کان وڌيڪ Y پسند آهي 'I like Y more than X'.

Note that **بهتر** 'better' is already comparative (like English *better*): don't add وڌيڪ to it.

grammar.title: The best, the worst, one of the best
grammar.body:
**Superlative = سڀ کان** 'than all' + adjective: **سڀ کان** سٺو 'the best', **سڀ کان** مشهور 'the most famous', **سڀ کان** بور 'the most boring'. The adjective agrees as usual: سڀ کان سٺي فلم, سڀ کان سٺا گانا.

**In / of a group**: use **جو / جي / جا** 'of' with the group: ٽيم **جو** بهترين رانديگر 'the team's best player', دنيا **جي** سڀ کان مشهور راند 'the world's most popular sport', سال **جو** سڀ کان سٺو ڊرامو 'the best drama of the year'.

**بهترين** 'best, excellent' (from Persian) is a one-word superlative, very common in reviews and on TV: بهترين اداڪار 'best actor'. It doesn't change form.

**One of the best**: superlative + **oblique plural** noun + **مان هڪ** 'one out of': بهترين **رانديگرن مان هڪ** 'one of the best players', سڀ کان سٺن **گانن مان هڪ** 'one of the best songs'. Note the oblique plural ending **-an**: رانديگر → رانديگرن, گانو → گانن, فلم → فلمن.

**Ever / of my life**: زندگيءَ جو / جي: منهنجي زندگيءَ جي سڀ کان بور فلم 'the most boring film of my life'.

grammar.title: The more…, the more…: جيترو … اوترو …
grammar.body:
Sindhi builds 'the more…, the more…' with a **pair** of words, just like the جيڪو … سو and جڏهن … تڏهن pairs you know:

**جيترو** (as much as) … **اوترو** (that much) …

جيترو وڌيڪ ڏسندين، اوترو وڌيڪ مزو ايندو.
The more you watch, the more you'll enjoy it. (lit. as much more you'll watch, that much more fun will come)

• Add **وڌيڪ** 'more' or **گهٽ** 'less', or use an adverb like **جلدي**: جيترو **جلدي**، اوترو **بهتر** 'the sooner the better'.
• Both halves use the tense that fits: future for advice and predictions, present for general truths.
• جيترو and اوترو **agree** when they describe a noun: **جيترا** پئسا، **اوترو** خرچ 'the more money, the more spending'. With verbs and adverbs, use the plain جيترو / اوترو.
• Short, verbless versions are very common in speech: جيترو جلدي، اوترو بهتر.

The trap: don't use the **ايترو** 'this much' of unit 8 in the second half — the partner of جيترو is **اوترو**.

culture:
**Cricket** is the shared language of Pakistan. During the **PSL** (Pakistan Super League) every city has its team — Karachi Kings for Karachiites — and a Pakistan–India match empties the streets. Commentary and chatter mix Sindhi with English: *over, wicket, catch, run, out* are simply Sindhi words in a match. Karachi's Lyari district is the home of Pakistani **football** and boxing. The old Sindhi sport is **ملاکڙو** (malakhro) wrestling, still held at village fairs and at the urs of saints.

**Music** in Sindh is deeply Sufi: Shah Abdul Latif's verses are sung every night at Bhit Shah, and singers like **Abida Parveen**, Allan Faqir, Mai Bhagi and Sanam Marvi carry the tradition, while **Coke Studio** brought Sindhi songs to young audiences nationwide. At weddings everyone dances to **هو جمالو**. Sindhi-language TV (KTN, Kawish, Sindh TV) has its own dramas, but most families also follow the big Urdu dramas — and discuss each episode at length.

Recommending is enthusiastic: **ضرور ڏس!**, **ڪمال آهي!** If you didn't like something, soften it: ٺيڪ هو، پر… 'it was OK, but…'.

lessons.title: Which is better?

tip.title: Better than, not as good as
tip.body:
- X **کان** + adjective = more … than X; add **گهڻو** 'much' or **ٿورو** 'a bit': ان کان **گهڻو** بهتر.
- **Not as … as** = X **جيترو** … ناهي, agreeing: ان **جيتري** سٺي ناهي (f).
- I like Y more than X = مون کي X کان وڌيڪ Y پسند آهي.
tip.pattern: X کان (گهڻو / ٿورو) + adj · X جيترو + adj + ناهي

sentences.roman: ṭī vī te maichu halī rahyo āhe.
sentences.en: The match is on TV.

tip.title: The best: سڀ کان / بهترين
tip.body:
- Superlative = **سڀ کان** + adjective: سڀ کان سٺو، سڀ کان مشهور.
- 'Of' a group = **جو / جي / جا**: ٽيم **جو** بهترين رانديگر.
- **بهترين** = best (never changes).
- One of the best = بهترين **رانديگرن مان هڪ** (oblique plural -an).
tip.pattern: group + جو/جي + سڀ کان + adj + noun

sentences.native: هو ٽيم جو بهترين رانديگر آهي.
sentences.roman: hū ṭīma jo bihtarīnu rāndigaru āhe.
sentences.en: He's the best player in the team.

sentences.native: فٽبال دنيا جي سڀ کان مشهور راند آهي.

sentences.en: Football is the world's most popular sport.

sentences.roman: pākistāna meṃ krikeṭa sabha khāṃ vaɗī rānda āhe.

sentences.native: لياري جا ڇوڪرا فٽبال جا بهترين رانديگر آهن.

sentences.native: توهان کي سڀ کان وڌيڪ ڪهڙو رانديگر پسند آهي؟

sentences.native: ٻار ٻاهر راند پيا کيڏن.
sentences.roman: ɓāra ɓāhari rānda pyā kheɗan.

lessons.title: Free time: the more, the better

tip.title: The more…, the more…
tip.body:
- **جيترو** … **اوترو** … = the more …, the more …
- Add وڌيڪ / گهٽ / جلدي: جيترو **جلدي**، اوترو **بهتر**.
- With a noun they agree: **جيترا** دوست، **اوترو** مزو.
- The partner of جيترو is **اوترو**, not ايترو.

new: جيترو ٻڌان ٿو، اوترو وڌيڪ وڻي ٿو.

sentences.native: جيترو وڌيڪ ڊرامو ڏسان ٿو، اوترو وڌيڪ پسند اچي ٿو.
sentences.roman: jetiro vadhīku ḍrāmo ɗisāṃ tho, otiro vadhīku pasanda ache tho.
sentences.en: The more I watch the drama, the more I like it. (man)

sentences.native: جيترو جلدي نڪرنداسين، اوترو جلدي پهچنداسين.
sentences.roman: jetiro jaldī nikirandāsīṃ, otiro jaldī pahuchandāsīṃ.
sentences.en: The sooner we leave, the sooner we'll get there.

sentences.native: جيترو وڌيڪ سنڌي ڳالهائيندين، اوترو آسان ٿيندي.
sentences.roman: jetiro vadhīku sindhī ɠālhāīndeṃ, otiro āsānu thīndī.
sentences.en: The more Sindhi you speak, the easier it gets. (to a friend)

sentences.native: جيترو گهٽ سمهندس، اوترو وڌيڪ ٿڪل هوندس.
sentences.roman: jetiro ghaṭu sumhandus, otiro vadhīku thakalu hundus.
sentences.en: The less I sleep, the more tired I'll be. (man)

sentences.native: جيترو جلدي، اوترو بهتر.
sentences.roman: jetiro jaldī, otiro bihtaru.
sentences.en: The sooner, the better.

sentences.native: جيترو وڌيڪ جم ويندين، اوترو بهتر ٿيندو.
sentences.roman: jetiro vadhīku jimu vendeṃ, otiro bihtaru thīndo.
sentences.en: The more you go to the gym, the better. (to a friend)

sentences.native: جيترا وڌيڪ دوست، اوترو وڌيڪ مزو.
sentences.roman: jetirā vadhīku dosta, otiro vadhīku mazo.
sentences.en: The more friends, the more fun.

sentences.native: منهنجو مشغلو ڪتاب پڙهڻ آهي.
sentences.roman: munhinjo mashġalo kitāba paṛhaṇu āhe.
sentences.en: My hobby is reading.

sentences.native: اسان سڄي شام ڪچهريءَ ۾ گذاري.
sentences.roman: asāṃ saʄī shāma kachahrīa meṃ guzārī.
sentences.en: We spent the whole evening chatting.

sentences.native: موڪل جو ڏينهن ڪيئن گذاريندين؟
